description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the named subarea. Traffic-impact-fee service-area polygons identify where fees support transportation improvements for higher travel demand generated by new development. These source-defined assets, service areas or operating constraints provide inputs for capacity planning studies. The geometry describes the charging/planning areas, not fee amounts, collected revenue or completed improvements. Access is through the public county catalogue and ArcGIS REST layer metadata, with GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile export descriptors advertised by the provider. No feature records or files were downloaded. Licence terms are referred to a county PDF that was not opened; charges are not stated. The additional county GIS metadata HTML route failed during TLS negotiation. A limitation is that field definitions do not establish attribute completeness, present serviceability or observation dates. A regular update frequency is not stated. No exact related active resource was established for this group.
